prompts.name: search
prompts.description: Guided API discovery with intelligent filtering. Find APIs by organization (CN, SBG, CTG, CX, etc.), style (REST, gRPC, GraphQL), deployment type (Cloud, On-prem), or status (ACTIVE, EOL, ONBOARDING). Returns a curated summary with names, descriptions, and key characteristics. Use this for exploratory API searches when you need context and recommendations.

prompts.name: api-quality-metrics
prompts.description: Comprehensive API quality analysis with metrics and governance insights. Analyzes quality champions, initiative enrollments, approval thresholds, and DevX review status. Provides actionable recommendations for quality improvements. Use this for API governance, quality audits, and continuous improvement planning.

prompts.name: list-deprecated-apis
prompts.description: Track deprecated and end-of-life APIs with sunset timelines and migration paths. Identifies APIs with DEPRECATED or EOL status, provides sunset timeline information from releases, and suggests migration alternatives. Essential for API lifecycle management, customer communication, and technical debt planning.

prompts.name: organization-report
prompts.description: Comprehensive organization analysis across the API Inventory. Provides statistical breakdown of API styles, deployment types, lifecycle stages, and status distribution. Optionally includes SDK information with platform and language analysis. Highlights key APIs, notable trends, and strategic focus areas. Perfect for portfolio reviews, strategic planning, and stakeholder reporting.

prompts.name: getting-started
prompts.description: Complete guide to using the API Inventory MCP Server effectively. Explains available tools, their parameters, common workflows, and best practices. Shows real examples for each tool and how to combine them for complex queries. Perfect for first-time users or when you need a refresher on capabilities. Use this prompt when you're unsure which tool to use or how to structure your query.

tools.name: search

kind.description: Filter by card type: API (REST, gRPC, GraphQL, etc.), SDK (JavaScript, Python, Swift, etc.), MCP (Model Context Protocol servers), or GROUP (logical collections). **Required when using organization filter**.

audience.description: Filter by target audience: EXTERNAL (public customer/partner facing) or INTERNAL (Cisco-internal). Default: EXTERNAL. GROUP cards are automatically included if they contain any matching API/SDK/MCP cards.

organization.description: Filter by organization code (CN, SBG, CTG, CX, Operations, CSDI, Splunk, Sales). **Requires kind to be "API", "SDK", or "MCP"**. GROUP cards do not have organization. Supports partial matching when partial=true

name.description: Filter by card name or alternate names. Case-insensitive with partial matching by default. Example: "defense" matches "AI Defense API"

partial.description: Enable partial/substring matching for name and organization (default: true). Set to false for exact matches only

details.description: Return only specific section: contacts (team info), releases (versions/status), api_quality (metrics), api_insights (org mapping), or info (basic metadata)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response. Use the "cursor" value returned in results to fetch next page

pageSize.description: Number of results per page. Default is from config (typically 10), maximum 100. Returns hasMore=true if more results available

tools.name: refresh-cache
tools.description:
Manually trigger an inventory refresh from the remote URL. The server automatically refreshes every 15 minutes, but this tool allows on-demand updates. Returns the new version number and update status. Note: Updates only occur if the remote version is different from the cached version.

Common Usage Pattern:
1. Check for updates: {} (no parameters needed)

Parameter Details:
- No parameters required

Returns:
- success: true/false
- message: Status description
- version: Current inventory version

Error Handling:
- Returns -32001 (ServiceUnavailable) if remote inventory URL is unreachable (retryable)
- Returns -32603 (InternalError) for other server-side issues

tools.name: stats

groupBy.description: Group statistics by: organization (CN, SBG, CTG, etc.), status (ACTIVE, EOL, ONBOARDING), kind (API, SDK, MCP), deployment (Cloud, On-prem), lifecycle (Product-led, API-led, etc.), or audience (EXTERNAL, INTERNAL). Omit to get default grouping by kind. Returns total count and breakdown with counts per group

audience.description: Filter statistics by target audience: EXTERNAL (public customer/partner facing) or INTERNAL (Cisco-internal). Default: EXTERNAL. GROUP cards are always excluded from statistics as they do not have an audience field.

tools.name: list-organizations
tools.description: List all Cisco organizations present in the inventory. Returns an array of organization codes (e.g., CN, SBG, CTG, CX, Operations, CSDI, Splunk, Sales). Useful for agent discoverability and UI dropdowns.

tools.name: schema-version
tools.description: Get information about inventory schema version compatibility. Returns the supported schema version, current inventory version, and compatibility status. Use this to check if the loaded inventory is compatible with the MCP server.

tools.name: get-card
tools.description:
Retrieve detailed information for a specific card by its ID. This tool provides the same functionality as the card:/// resource but is compatible with MCP clients that do not support resource fetching (e.g., GitHub Copilot). Returns complete card metadata including name, description, contacts, releases, and quality metrics.

Common Usage Patterns:
1. Get full card details: {"id": "cisco-secure-network-analytics-api"}
2. Get specific section: {"id": "card-id", "details": "contacts"}
3. Check releases: {"id": "card-id", "details": "releases"}

Parameter Details:
- id: Card identifier (use search tool to find IDs)
- details (optional): contacts, releases, api_quality, api_insights, info

Note: For MCP clients with resource support, use card:///{id} resource instead.

Error Handling:
- Returns -32602 (InvalidParams) for invalid parameters
- Returns -32603 (InternalError) if card not found or server error

id.description: The unique identifier of the card to retrieve (e.g., "cisco-secure-network-analytics-api")

details.description: Return only specific section: contacts (team info), releases (versions/status), api_quality (metrics), api_insights (org mapping), or info (basic metadata)

Optionally includes SDK information with platform and language analysis. Highlights key APIs, notable trends, and strategic focus areas. Perfect for portfolio reviews, strategic planning, and stakeholder reporting.

prompts.name: getting-started
prompts.description: Complete guide to using the API Inventory MCP Server effectively. Explains available tools, their parameters, common workflows, and best practices. Shows real examples for each tool and how to combine them for complex queries. Perfect for first-time users or when you need a refresher on capabilities. Use this prompt when you're unsure which tool to use or how to structure your query.

tools.name: search

kind.description: Filter by card type: API (REST, gRPC, GraphQL, etc.), SDK (JavaScript, Python, Swift, etc.), MCP (Model Context Protocol servers), or GROUP (logical collections). **Required when using organization filter**.

audience.description: Filter by target audience: EXTERNAL (public customer/partner facing) or INTERNAL (Cisco-internal). Default: EXTERNAL. GROUP cards are automatically included if they contain any matching API/SDK/MCP cards.

organization.description: Filter by organization code (CN, SBG, CTG, CX, Operations, CSDI, Splunk, Sales). **Requires kind to be "API", "SDK", or "MCP"**. GROUP cards do not have organization. Supports partial matching when partial=true

name.description: Filter by card name or alternate names. Case-insensitive with partial matching by default. Example: "defense" matches "AI Defense API"

partial.description: Enable partial/substring matching for name and organization (default: true). Set to false for exact matches only

details.description: Return only specific section: contacts (team info), releases (versions/status), api_quality (metrics), api_insights (org mapping), or info (basic metadata)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response. Use the "cursor" value returned in results to fetch next page

pageSize.description: Number of results per page. Default is from config (typically 10), maximum 100. Returns hasMore=true if more results available

tools.name: refresh-cache
tools.description:
Manually trigger an inventory refresh from the remote URL. The server automatically refreshes every 15 minutes, but this tool allows on-demand updates. Returns the new version number and update status. Note: Updates only occur if the remote version is different from the cached version.

Common Usage Pattern:
1. Check for updates: {} (no parameters needed)

Parameter Details:
- No parameters required

Returns:
- success: true/false
- message: Status description
- version: Current inventory version

Error Handling:
- Returns -32001 (ServiceUnavailable) if remote inventory URL is unreachable (retryable)
- Returns -32603 (InternalError) for other server-side issues

tools.name: stats

groupBy.description: Group statistics by: organization (CN, SBG, CTG, etc.), status (ACTIVE, EOL, ONBOARDING), kind (API, SDK, MCP), deployment (Cloud, On-prem), lifecycle (Product-led, API-led, etc.), or audience (EXTERNAL, INTERNAL). Omit to get default grouping by kind. Returns total count and breakdown with counts per group

audience.description: Filter statistics by target audience: EXTERNAL (public customer/partner facing) or INTERNAL (Cisco-internal). Default: EXTERNAL. GROUP cards are always excluded from statistics as they do not have an audience field.

tools.name: list-organizations
tools.description: List all Cisco organizations present in the inventory. Returns an array of organization codes (e.g., CN, SBG, CTG, CX, Operations, CSDI, Splunk, Sales). Useful for agent discoverability and UI dropdowns.

tools.name: schema-version
tools.description: Get information about inventory schema version compatibility. Returns the supported schema version, current inventory version, and compatibility status. Use this to check if the loaded inventory is compatible with the MCP server.

tools.name: get-card
tools.description:
Retrieve detailed information for a specific card by its ID. This tool provides the same functionality as the card:/// resource but is compatible with MCP clients that do not support resource fetching (e.g., GitHub Copilot). Returns complete card metadata including name, description, contacts, releases, and quality metrics.

Common Usage Patterns:
1. Get full card details: {"id": "cisco-secure-network-analytics-api"}
2. Get specific section: {"id": "card-id", "details": "contacts"}
3. Check releases: {"id": "card-id", "details": "releases"}

Parameter Details:
- id: Card identifier (use search tool to find IDs)
- details (optional): contacts, releases, api_quality, api_insights, info

Note: For MCP clients with resource support, use card:///{id} resource instead.

Error Handling:
- Returns -32602 (InvalidParams) for invalid parameters
- Returns -32603 (InternalError) if card not found or server error

id.description: The unique identifier of the card to retrieve (e.g., "cisco-secure-network-analytics-api")

details.description: Return only specific section: contacts (team info), releases (versions/status), api_quality (metrics), api_insights (org mapping), or info (basic metadata)

prompts.name: search
prompts.description: Guided API discovery with intelligent filtering. Find APIs by organization (CN, SBG, CTG, CX, etc.), style (REST, gRPC, GraphQL), deployment type (Cloud, On-prem), or status (ACTIVE, EOL, ONBOARDING). Returns a curated summary with names, descriptions, and key characteristics. Use this for exploratory API searches when you need context and recommendations.

prompts.name: api-quality-metrics
prompts.description: Comprehensive API quality analysis with metrics and governance insights. Analyzes quality champions, initiative enrollments, approval thresholds, and DevX review status. Provides actionable recommendations for quality improvements. Use this for API governance, quality audits, and continuous improvement planning.

prompts.name: list-deprecated-apis
prompts.description: Track deprecated and end-of-life APIs with sunset timelines and migration paths. Identifies APIs with DEPRECATED or EOL status, provides sunset timeline information from releases, and suggests migration alternatives. Essential for API lifecycle management, customer communication, and technical debt planning.
